responsibility: This header supplies shared GCC configuration for MIPS targets running Linux-based GNU systems in ELF format, including Android-capable combinations. It overrides preprocessor builtins and the CC1, linker, library, startfile, and endfile specs to choose between GNU-user and Android behavior, and it sets stack-checking support and protection sizes, acting as the common OS-layer glue between the generic MIPS GNU-user setup and Linux/Android-specific driver behavior.
